scope: Add narrated interactive house books, a local video library, dinosaur toys and a discovery mini-game to the existing main research plan.
status: Research/design only. No Unity implementation, generated media, imported video, or device verification.
distinction: Capabilities and factual dinosaur references are sourced. UI flows, content counts, scripts, interaction rules, storage estimates, encoding starting points, and implementation architecture are proposals or stated calculations.

sources.title: Benefits and Pitfalls of Multimedia and Interactive Features in Technology-Enhanced Storybooks: A Meta-Analysis

sources.access: Full article read during research; a later repeat request timed out. No per-page hotspot count is prescribed by this study.
